name: Velvet-Scourge Syndicate
identity: Pain-addicted duelists, sonic cultists and rapture-engines. Fast and fragile; hurting them makes them better, and once per round they offer the opponent a Temptation where the opponent chooses which punishment to take.

rules.name: Ecstasy of Pain
rules.description: A Velvet-Scourge unit that is below Starting Strength (or damaged), or that destroyed an enemy model this round, gets +1 to Hit and +1″ MOV.

rules.name: Gamble — Temptation
rules.description: Once per round, when a unit is selected to Shoot or Fight, offer the opponent a Temptation. The OPPONENT chooses: the target unit suffers D3 Fatal Wounds now, OR your unit's weapons gain [ONSLAUGHT 2] for this attack. (Risk: opponent's choice.)

detachments.name: Sonic Choir
detachments.playstyle: Sonic gunline that strips cover and shuts down reactions.

rules.name: Cacophony of Sonic Blasters
rules.description: Ranged weapons have [IGNORES COVER] and [ASSAULT]; units hit by them cannot make ranged Retaliation Strikes until the End of Round.

enhancements.name: Doom-Siren
enhancements.description: **Cacophony Paladins** only. +1 PEN with ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Overwhelming Noise
stratagems.effect: It suffers −1 to Hit this activation.

stratagems.name: Encore
stratagems.turn: A unit destroys an enemy unit by Shooting

detachments.name: Masque of Blades
detachments.playstyle: Duelists and dancers that slip in and out of melee.

rules.name: Quicksilver Grace
rules.description: All Velvet-Scourge units may Fall Back and still Shoot or Charge. Leaders have [STRIKE FIRST].

enhancements.name: Duelist's Garter
enhancements.description: **Blade-Diva Champion** only. +1 Damage in melee on a round she charged.

stratagems.name: Euphoric Kill-High
stratagems.turn: A unit destroys an enemy unit in melee

stratagems.name: Feint
stratagems.turn: A unit is targeted by a Charge
stratagems.effect: It makes a 3″ move; if the Charge then fails, the charger is Rattled.

stratagems.name: Exquisite Agony
stratagems.turn: A unit is selected to Fight
stratagems.effect: Count it as below Starting Strength.

detachments.name: Carnival of Excess
detachments.playstyle: Rapture-engines, chariots and beasts in a gaudy charge.

rules.name: Grand Spectacle
rules.description: Class 3–5 units get +2″ MOV in Round 1 and +1 Attack in melee while below Starting Strength.

enhancements.name: Ringmaster's Whip
enhancements.description: **Maestro of Excess** only. Friendly units within 6″ get +1 Attack on a round they charged.

stratagems.name: Gaudy Distraction
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit targets a Class 1–2 unit within 6″ of a Class 3–5 unit
stratagems.effect: It must target the Class 3–5 unit if visible.

stratagems.name: Rapture-Rush
stratagems.turn: A Class 3–5 unit is below half
stratagems.effect: +1 to Hit and +2″ MOV until the End of Round.
